senses.gloss:
उरी ind. A particle, implying, (especially in composition.)
 1. Promise,
assent.
 2. Expansion; also उररी and ऊरी.

ऊरी ind. A particle of, 1. Assent.
 2. Of expansion: see उरी.

उरीकार m. (-रः)
 1. Promise.
 2. Extension.
 E. उरी, and कार what makes.

उरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Promised.
 2. Expanded, spread.
 E. उरी and
कृत made; also उररीकृत and ऊरीकृत.

ऊरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Promised.
 2. Expanded.
 E. ऊरी and कृत made:
see उरीकृत.
